title: FAO Pond construction for freshwater fish culture — Detailed planning, §12.7 Table 51

retrieval.scope: Official full chapter body via browser, §12.7 Table 51

facts.statement: Manual soft alluvial/sandy soil excavation and throwing 1 m away for average-strength workers is 2.5–3 cubic metres per 8 hours by hoe and 3.5–4 by pick/shovel.
Higher soil hardness and excess water reduce outputs; these are planning standards.

limits: Not an experimental time series for improvised tools or an isolated island.
No matching lining, transport, roof-building or hand-power measurements obtained.
